summary: EZCORP filed an 8-K reporting it acquired the remaining 12.3% of Founders One, LLC membership interests on May 14, 2026, achieving 100% ownership, and on May 15, 2026, through Founders, bought 1,360.65 shares of Simple Management Group (SMG) from minority holders, raising its SMG stake to 93%. No price per share, premium, or total deal value was disclosed. The board did not make a recommendation and no advisors were named. The transaction had no regulatory clock; it closed immediately. What to watch: EZCORP may seek full ownership of SMG in the near future.
